The DICOM tag for **Modality** is **(0008,0060)**.

## Details

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **Tag** | (0008,0060) |
| **Group** | 0008 (General Information / SOP Common related group) |
| **Element** | 0060 |
| **Keyword** | Modality |
| **VR (Value Representation)** | CS (Code String) |
| **VM (Value Multiplicity)** | 1 |

## About the Modality Attribute

The Modality attribute identifies the **type of equipment** that acquired the data used to create the images in a DICOM series. It is a **Series-level attribute** (part of the General Series Module).

## Common Modality Values (Defined Terms)

Some frequently used values include:

- **CT** — Computed Tomography
- **MR** — Magnetic Resonance
- **US** — Ultrasound
- **XA** — X-Ray Angiography
- **CR** — Computed Radiography
- **DX** — Digital Radiography
- **MG** — Mammography
- **NM** — Nuclear Medicine
- **PT** — Positron Emission Tomography (PET)
- **RF** — Radio Fluoroscopy
- **OT** — Other

These codes are defined by the DICOM standard and are also referenced in related standards work (e.g., IHE profiles and HL7 mappings for imaging interoperability).
